cues.title: 同样滴碱，两种沉淀
cues.caption: Fe³⁺生成红褐色沉淀；新生Fe(OH)₂很快受空气影响。
cues.captionEn: Fe³⁺ gives a brown precipitate; freshly formed Fe(OH)₂ is quickly affected by air.
cues.zh: 两支试管分别装有氯化铁和硫酸亚铁。加入氢氧化钠，铁离子与氢氧根结合形成难溶沉淀。三价铁的一管出现红褐色，二价铁的一管在理想新生状态很浅，但在普通空气条件下，很难长时间保持这个起点。
cues.en: One tube contains iron three chloride, the other iron two sulfate. Added hydroxide forms insoluble precipitates. The iron three tube turns brown. Fresh iron two hydroxide is very pale in its ideal initial state, but that starting point is difficult to preserve under ordinary air exposure.

cues.title: 追踪空气带来的改变
cues.titleEn: Follow the change caused by air
cues.caption: O₂参与，Fe(OH)₂逐步转成含三价铁的沉淀。
cues.captionEn: O₂ participates as Fe(OH)₂ changes into a precipitate containing Fe(III).
cues.zh: 教材记录的是白色迅速变成灰绿色，之后出现红褐色物质。变化需要氧气参与，不能只把它理解为等待时间带来的自动变色。这里用颜色序列重现观察，用教材的净反应追踪二价铁转成三价铁；灰绿色并不是本画面鉴定出的某一种纯物质。
cues.en: The textbook records a pale precipitate rapidly becoming grey-green, followed by brown material. Oxygen participates in the change: it is not a colour switch triggered merely by waiting. The colour sequence represents the observation, while the textbook net equation tracks oxidation from iron two to iron three. Grey-green does not identify a single pure material here.

cues.title: 四个铁中心，一个氧分子
cues.titleEn: Four iron centres, one oxygen molecule
cues.caption: 每消耗1份O₂，最多使4份Fe(II)氧化成Fe(III)。
cues.captionEn: One amount of O₂ can oxidize at most four amounts of Fe(II) to Fe(III).
cues.zh: 放大的是计量关系，不是真实晶体结构。四个铁中心始终都在，氧气和水参与后，每个铁由二价转成三价。模型保留四比一的铁与氧气关系。若氧气不足，二价铁沉淀会有剩余；若没有先形成沉淀，也不能凭空出现这条转化路径。
cues.en: This close view shows stoichiometry, not the crystal structure. All four iron centres remain present as oxygen and water participate and iron two becomes iron three. The model preserves the four-to-one relation between iron and oxygen. Insufficient oxygen leaves iron two precipitate behind, and this pathway cannot create solid that was never precipitated.

cues.title: 把氧气作为对照条件
cues.titleEn: Use oxygen as the comparison condition
cues.caption: 隔绝O₂与有O₂的理想对照分离了沉淀和后续氧化。
cues.captionEn: An ideal comparison with and without O₂ separates precipitation from later oxidation.
cues.zh: 把两份相同的亚铁沉淀分开比较。理想隔绝氧气的一份保留二价铁；有足量氧气并完成转化的一份变成红褐色。实际制备还受溶解氧、杂质和操作条件影响，所以这里的无氧状态是机制对照，不是保证现实试管一定保持纯白的操作说明。
cues.en: Compare two otherwise identical portions of iron two precipitate. An ideal oxygen-free portion retains iron two; with sufficient oxygen and completed conversion, the other becomes brown. Dissolved oxygen, impurities and handling affect real preparation. The oxygen-free state is a mechanistic control, not a promise that a real tube will stay perfectly white.

question.zh: 浅色沉淀为什么会变成红褐色？
question.en: Why does the pale precipitate turn brown?

lead.zh: 先看两种铁盐生成不同沉淀，再用同一批铁和有无氧气的对照追踪变化。
lead.en: Compare the two initial precipitates, then track the same iron with and without oxygen.

principle.zh: 沉淀先由OH⁻生成，随后O₂氧化Fe(II)。教材净账中每1份O₂最多对应4份铁氧化。
principle.en: OH⁻ first precipitates the hydroxide; O₂ then oxidizes iron(II). In the textbook net account, one O₂ can oxidize at most four iron centres.

question.zh: 若已有1mmol亚铁沉淀，但氧气仅0.125mmol，最终还有多少亚铁沉淀？
question.en: With 1 mmol of iron(II) precipitate but only 0.125 mmol O₂, how much iron(II) precipitate remains?

explanation.zh: 最多氧化0.500mmol，仍留0.500mmol；若没有先生成沉淀，这条路径不能凭空产生它。
explanation.en: At most 0.500 mmol is oxidized, leaving 0.500 mmol. This pathway cannot create precipitate that was never formed.
